Implement in backend app platform v12 schemaVersion migration

Problem In the frontend, DashboardMigrator handles the migration of a dashboard across different schema versions. From `schemaVersion` 1, the changes we have made in the dashboard schema have been migrated using this method. When a new version is added, a new `if (schemaVersion < X) do something` is added.
